title: Forbes Names Banner Bank the #1 Bank in California
summary: WALLA WALLA, Wash., August 10, 2026--The Banner Bank leadership team is pleased to announce Forbes has ranked the Bank number one in California on the 2026 list of America's Best-In-State Banks. The annual ranking, developed in partnership with Statista, recognizes banks that earn the highest marks from clients on trust, service, financial advice, digital tools and overall satisfaction.
